This proprietary, all-rights-reserved listing links to the publisher’s terms and setup; it does not bundle the paid app or grant copying rights. melmayssonowen/agent-skills/timetopost-s.text: Connect the hosted TimeToPost MCP at https://api.timetopost.co/mcp using an MCP client with remote HTTP support and browser OAuth for your TimeToPost account. Confirm workspace, available tools, and target accounts or publishing site before writes. Scheduling and publication require approval of the exact content and destination. Installing the skill folder alone does not configure the service. The reviewed offline URL helper replaces existing UTM attribution; preserve tagged campaign links manually until the correction in upstream PR #1 is accepted.

melmayssonowen/agent-skills/sheetfolk-bu.text: The local workbook helper requires Python 3 and no third-party packages. At the reviewed revision it overwrites an existing output path and the TOTAL row adds income to outflows. Use an unused output filename and calculate net cash flow separately until upstream PR #1 is accepted. The PR adds exclusive creation, net formulas, and regression tests.

melmayssonowen/agent-skills/amazon-listi.text: Requires Python 3. The local helper reads a JSON object from standard input and emits JSON findings without scraping or network access. Provide title, bullets, description, backend_terms, and main_keyword. Its fixed thresholds and wording flags are review prompts; verify current marketplace and category rules separately.

melmayssonowen/agent-skills/clef-music-t.text: The publisher documents https://clefdrills.com/mcp as a public, no-auth hosted MCP. Use a remote HTTP MCP client and check available tool schemas. Offline chord transposition uses Python 3 without additional packages. This review did not connect to the hosted service.

geekflare/geekflare-skills/geekflare.text: Requires a Geekflare account and GEEKFLARE_API_KEY. Requests send queries, URLs and options to Geekflare and consume account credits; the source documents a free tier. Use public pages and authorized diagnostic targets. Hosted MCP places the key in the URL path, so keep connection URLs out of logs and shared text. The optional local MCP command runs the unpinned npm package @geekflare/mcp. The hosted scraping service advertises CAPTCHA solving and anti-bot handling. REST docs default stealth, proxyMode and renderJS to false; proxyCountry independently enables proxy routing. CAPTCHA fallback behavior is unspecified. The npm runtime and hosted service were not tested.
